title.zh: Polymarket将就荷兰禁令提起诉讼
title.en: Polymarket将就荷兰禁令提起诉讼

current_state.zh: Polymarket 已向海牙地区法院提起诉讼，要求撤销 Ksa 的荷兰禁令并恢复市场准入，主张其事件合约应由 AFM 而非 Ksa 监管；Ksa 已收取 42 万欧元罚款。
current_state.en: Polymarket has sued at The Hague District Court to annul Ksa's Dutch ban and restore market access, arguing its event contracts should be supervised by AFM rather than Ksa; Ksa has collected €420k in fines.

updates.title_zh: Polymarket将就荷兰禁令提起诉讼
updates.title_en: Polymarket将就荷兰禁令提起诉讼
updates.what_changed_zh: Polymarket正就荷兰监管机构Ksa禁止其在荷兰运营的命令提起诉讼，主张其产品应由金融市场管理局AFM监管。
updates.what_changed_en: Polymarket is filing a lawsuit against the Dutch regulator Ksa's order barring it from operating in the Netherlands, arguing its product should instead be supervised by financial markets authority AFM.

updates.title_zh: 【Polymarket 向海牙法院起诉要求撤销荷兰禁令】
updates.title_en: 【Polymarket 向海牙法院起诉要求撤销荷兰禁令】
updates.what_changed_zh: Polymarket 已正式向海牙地区法院起诉，要求撤销荷兰禁令并恢复市场准入；Ksa 已因停服晚于期限收取 42 万欧元罚款。
updates.what_changed_en: Polymarket has formally filed suit at The Hague District Court seeking annulment of the Dutch ban and restoration of market access; Ksa has collected €420k in fines because service stopped after the deadline.
updates.current_state_zh: Polymarket 已向海牙地区法院提起诉讼，要求撤销 Ksa 的荷兰禁令并恢复市场准入，主张其事件合约应由 AFM 而非 Ksa 监管；Ksa 已收取 42 万欧元罚款。
updates.current_state_en: Polymarket has sued at The Hague District Court to annul Ksa's Dutch ban and restore market access, arguing its event contracts should be supervised by AFM rather than Ksa; Ksa has collected €420k in fines.
updates.detailed_summary_zh: Polymarket has sued at The Hague District Court to annul the Dutch gambling regulator's ban, arguing its event contracts are financial products that should be supervised by the financial markets authority rather than classified as unlicensed gambling that already drew €420k in fines.
updates.detailed_summary_en: Polymarket has sued at The Hague District Court to annul the Dutch gambling regulator's ban, arguing its event contracts are financial products that should be supervised by the financial markets authority rather than classified as unlicensed gambling that already drew €420k in fines.
